name: Babatunde Awoyemi
bio: Babatunde Ayoola Awoyemi holds a B.Sc. and M.Sc. in Physics from the University of Ibadan and leads Techbase Consultant Services as its Founder and Lead Consultant. An atmospheric physicist by training and a STEM educator by practice, Babatunde brings over a decade of experience designing and deploying practical technology curricula across schools and institutions. Beyond leading Techbase's core STEM, robotics, and EdTech training initiatives, his research focuses on solar radiation modelling, tropical climate dynamics, and wind energy potential.

name: Elvis Ihimire
bio: Elvis Ihimire is a versatile technology professional and STEM educator specialising in software development, artificial intelligence, and digital literacy. With hands-on expertise in Python, web technologies, MIT App Inventor, and robotics projects, Elvis equips primary and secondary school students with future-ready skills while delivering reliable IT support and technology solutions for organisations.

name: Favour Chibundu
bio: Favour Chibundu holds a B.Sc. in Computer Science from Lagos State University and brings proven experience as a Full-Stack Developer and technical instructor. Specialising in web development, database management, block-based programming, and robotics, Favour transforms complex concepts into practical, scalable digital solutions while empowering learners with essential STEM and software engineering skills.
